**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were ever red, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount. The spec taxes what the customer pays.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Fixed in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). Most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, so they passed either way. Nothing else to do.
